Section 4.4 says the rotor-1 rear spigot D100 'pilots' the spacer, which could mean a D100 recess in the spacer front face; the intent and the section 14.1 table call it a plain ring whose front face bears on the D100 boss, so no recess is modelled and radial location comes from the D40 bore.
Bore fit: the blisks carry a 10 um interference on the D40 h6 drum; the spacer fit is not stated and is modelled 40.0 line-to-line per the intent.
Edge breaks, surface finish, balance features and any anti-rotation dowel for the spacer are not stated; none are modelled.
